interface.shortDescription: Edit talking-head video in a measured style
interface.longDescription: Motus edits talking-head 9:16 video (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) in a chosen editing style. A local engine transcribes and samples the video, the agent plans the edit scene by scene with 2 to 4 options per scene, a local Studio page lets you pick, annotate and lock, and the engine renders the final MP4 through headless Chrome. Needs ffmpeg, Node 22 or newer, a Chromium-based browser and Python with faster-whisper on this machine.
